pre_install: $wrapper = '@echo off`r`npowershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$root = Split-Path -Parent ([Environment]::ExpandEnvironmentVariables(\"%~dp0\")); $exe = Get-ChildItem -Path $root -Recurse -File -Filter ''Tiro Notes.exe'' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1; if (-not $exe) { Write-Error ''Tiro Notes.exe was not found in the installed files.''; exit 1 }; Start-Process -FilePath $exe.FullName -WorkingDirectory $exe.DirectoryName -ArgumentList $args" %*'

script: if (-not $release) { throw 'No numbered Tiro Notes release containing tiro-notes-win-x64.zip was found.' }
